'''Arbiya''', officially the '''Republic of Arbiya''', is a sovereign landlocked country located in the northern hemisphere. It is a [[wikipedia:Unitary_parliamentary_republic|unitary parliamentary republic]] bordered by [[Raledria]] to the south, from which it shares a deep-seated and complex historical lineage, [[Gaeiya]] to the west and [[Genaire]] to the north. It spans an area of 551,835 square kilometres (213,065 sq mi), and it is the [[List of countries and dependencies by area|60th largest nation by land area]]. It has a population of approximately [[List of countries and dependencies by population|6.5 million]]. Its capital and largest metropolitan centre is [[Karevu]], which serves as the nation’s primary hub for commerce, culture, and governance. Arbiya is a linguistically distinct nation, with [[Lycroan language|Lycroan]] serving as the official language, while [[Emaran language|Emaran]] holds significant status as a recognised regional language, with most residents able to speak both fluently.

The human history of Arbiya began in the wake of the [[discovery of Atirha]] in 1240. While the south saw [[Taval|Tavalan]] and [[Ayuma|Ayuman]] colonisation, the northern territories were settled by [[Lycroa|Lycroan]] and [[Emara|Emaran]] traders starting in 1391. Originally part of the wider colonial fabric that fueled the early [[wikipedia:Plantation_economy|plantation economies]] through forced labour, the sector shifted during the [[Seniaaii Revolution]] in Ayuma. As the Crown’s grip weakened, the [[colonial Declaration of Independence]] in 1549 saw the former colonies split between [[Gaeiya]] and [[Raledria]]. In the [[Great Atirhan War]] in 1612, [[Goieqa Arbiya]] led a rebellion against Geaya, avoiding total annexation by allying itself to Raledria and, concerning its foreign diplomacy to its neighbour, eventually being formalised as a [[Raledrian Dominion]] in 1622 AFA.

Originally settled by [[Lycroa|Lycroan traders]], the nation had a population boom by the early-16th century in the [[Arbiyan Gold Rush]], which triggered a massive wave of immigration and rapid urban expansion. This demographic boom was followed by an era of intense [[wikipedia:Industrialisation|industrialisation]]; leveraging some of the world’s largest [[wikipedia:Iron|iron deposits]], Arbiya became the primary metallurgical engine for Raledria’s own [[wikipedia:Industrial_Revolution|industrial revolution]]. This immense mineral wealth provided the economic leverage necessary for Arbiya to stay independent. While Raledria rose to global hegemony following the [[Red War]] and the subsequent [[Cold War]] against the [[Estijan Huan]], and [[Dahe]]. It leveraged its "Dominion" status to develop a distinct national identity separate from its southern neighbour. In 1732, after decades of rising tensions, Arbiya achieved full [[independence]]. It still maintains its so-called "[[Special Relationship]]" with Raledria, often being called siblings.

Arbiya is classified as a [[wikipedia:Developing_country|highly developed nation]]. While its population density remains low at [[List of countries and dependencies by population density|11.9 people per square kilometre]], its urban centres are clustered in the south. The nation ranks [[List of countries by GDP (PPP) per capita|23rd in GDP (PPP) per capita]], reflecting a high standard of living and a strong social safety net. Arbiya is a "left-hand drive" jurisdiction and utilises the [[Rassew]] (RSS) as its national currency. As a [[wikipedia:Unitary_parliamentary_republic|unitary parliamentary republic]], it is governed by a High Minister and a Low Minister, a unique dual-executive system that ensures regional representation within the central government.
